plugins.name: Winc
plugins.description: Open the focused Windows or WSL directory in Winc or File Explorer. Requires an installed copy of Winc.
plugins.description_zh: 在 Winc 或文件资源管理器打开当前 Windows 或 WSL 窗格的目录。需要本机已安装 Winc。

plugins.name: Scratch Terminal
plugins.description: Open a hideable shell for the current tab. Dock it below the terminal or move and resize it as a floating panel.
plugins.description_zh: 给当前标签加一个可隐藏的命令行，可停靠在下方，也可浮动、移动和缩放。
